card.name: The digit 2 inside long numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 2 when it appears as a middle digit within a multi-digit number or decimal, after one or more digits. It shows up in tables, dose charts, measurements and dates.

modes.label: Middle 2 in whole numbers
modes.description: The digit 2 sits between other digits in a larger integer such as a year or a calculated value.

modes.label: 2 after a decimal point
modes.description: The digit 2 is the first or second decimal digit in a table value or dose volume.

card.writes: It pushes toward a following 'nd' style letter pair, which does not fit a number context well, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the digit 2 when it sits in the middle of a longer number, as in dose tables and measurements.
